text:
Alex (PM): putting a proposal here for a cross-functional DP picklist + gating flow. want something lightweight we can actually run without backlogs.
Rohit (Eng): agree. infra prefers predictable cadence over more partners.
Sofia (ProdOps): ops constraint: 5 active DPs max, 2 of them high-touch. otherwise support queue balloons.
Ben (Research): scoring should prioritize partners who commit to recorded sessions + structured evals. that multiplies signal.
Ivy (Design): aim for feature coverage: at least one payments, one search/qa, one builder-tool app in a quarter.
Alex (PM): tentative scoring weights: participation_prob 30%, customer_value 25%, domain_coverage 20%, eval_depth 15%, compliance_flag 10%.
Rohit (Eng): treat compliance as a routing flag: "needs-private" not auto-reject. record it and route to the private-deploy pipeline.
Ben (Research): quick calc we can run in sheets:
```nscore = 0.3*p + 0.25*v + 0.2*d + 0.15*e + 0.1*(1 - c)
```
Ivy (Design): add a secondary "infra-test-value" boolean for partners who will validate streaming, tool-calls, or vector DBs. use only for tie-breaks.
Sofia (ProdOps): intake form must capture: weekly eval cadence, avg prompt length, concurrency, expected traffic, sensitive_data boolean.
Alex (PM): promotion gate DP->beta: >=75% engagement across the loop, no unresolved infra blocks, and a measurable improvement on a success metric they care about.
notify-bot: scheduling reminders for mid-loop and final reviews. :robot_face:
Sofia (ProdOps): action items: I'll update intake sheet + reminders.
Ben (Research): I'll publish the scoring sheet template.
Ivy (Design): mapping vertical targets now.
Rohit (Eng): adding infra metadata fields.
Alex (PM): i'll assemble a 1-page playbook and share in #product by Friday. thanks team.
